# google_storage_control_project_intelligence_config

Reads a Cloud Storage Control ProjectIntelligenceConfig during a Terraform operation without persisting its returned values in plan or state files.

Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Ephemeral values can be used in supported contexts such as provider configurations and write-only resource arguments.
See [Using ephemeral resources](../guides/using_ephemeral_resources.html.markdown).

## Example Usage

```hcl
ephemeral "google_storage_control_project_intelligence_config" "example" {
  name = "YOUR_NAME"
}
```

## Argument Reference

* `name` - (Required) 
  Identifier of the GCP project. For GCP project, this field can be project name or project number.

## Attributes Reference


* `edition_config` - 
  Edition configuration of the Storage Intelligence resource. Valid values are INHERIT, TRIAL, DISABLED and STANDARD.


* `update_time` - 
  The time at which the Storage Intelligence Config resource is last updated.


* `filter` - 
  Filter over location and bucket using include or exclude semantics. Resources that match the include or exclude filter are exclusively included or excluded from the Storage Intelligence plan.


* `filter.excluded_cloud_storage_buckets` - 
  Buckets to exclude from the Storage Intelligence plan.


* `filter.excluded_cloud_storage_buckets.bucket_id_regexes` - 
  List of bucket id regexes to exclude in the storage intelligence plan.


* `filter.included_cloud_storage_buckets` - 
  Buckets to include in the Storage Intelligence plan.


* `filter.included_cloud_storage_buckets.bucket_id_regexes` - 
  List of bucket id regexes to exclude in the storage intelligence plan.


* `filter.excluded_cloud_storage_locations` - 
  Locations to exclude from the Storage Intelligence plan.


* `filter.excluded_cloud_storage_locations.locations` - 
  List of locations.


* `filter.included_cloud_storage_locations` - 
  Locations to include in the Storage Intelligence plan.


* `filter.included_cloud_storage_locations.locations` - 
  List of locations.


* `effective_intelligence_config` - 
  The Intelligence config that is effective for the resource.


* `effective_intelligence_config.intelligence_config` - 
  The Intelligence config resource that is applied for the target resource.


* `effective_intelligence_config.effective_edition` - 
  The `StorageIntelligence` edition that is applicable for the resource.


* `trial_config` - 
  The trial configuration of the Storage Intelligence resource.


* `trial_config.expire_time` - 
  The time at which the trial expires.
